description.en: A developer and a designer clarify an error message.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could we make the wording of this error more specific?
dialogue.zh: 我们能把这个错误提示的措辞写得更明确吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. It should explain why the upload failed.
dialogue.zh: 可以。它应该解释上传为什么失败。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's show a retry button on this monitor as well.
dialogue.zh: 我们也在这个显示器上展示重试按钮吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Agreed. The message should help people decide what to do next.
dialogue.zh: 同意。提示应该帮助用户决定下一步怎么做。

communication_goal: 把错误提示的措辞写得更具体，帮助用户决定下一步。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two coworkers stand on opposite sides of a desk monitor. One points at an abstract warning triangle on the screen. Entire monitor and stand fully visible. No readable message or text.

coverage_review.scope: W017 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：完整显示器与支架，屏幕警示图标不证明具体错误措辞。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
